newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India tenders to buy 1.0-percent April diesel.
newsitem.headline: India tenders to buy 1.0-percent April diesel.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has issued a tender to buy 1.0 percent sulphur diesel for deliveries in April, traders said on Tuesday.
The tender closes February 20 and is valid until February 21.
It seeks 40,000-45,000-tonne cargoes for delivery to Madras or Haldia on the east coast and to Kandla on the west coast. It also seeks a 30,000-tonne cargoe for delivery to Goa or Kandla.

India bought a total of 575,000-tonnes of 1.0 percent sulphur diesel, 90,000-tonnes of 0.5 percent sulphur diesel and 45,000-tonnes of 0.25 percent sulphur diesel in three tenders for March delivery cargoes. --Singapore Newsroom (+65-870-3093)
